messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning the catalog lifecycle sprint. I want to close scope for onboarding benchmarks, pin policy, and retirement lanes. Need alignment by EOD Friday. TL;DR: propose 3 lanes: fast-onboard, vetted-stable, legacy-retire.

aj: Can you share constraints? capacity, timeline, and which customers get early notice?

sam: For benchmarks we should split: perf (latency/cost) vs quality (eval suites). Initial proposal: p95 latency <= 150ms for 256 tokens on our standard GPU profile; cost within 15% of current baseline; quality top-1 match >= 92% on the curated eval set.

lin: Customer signals: BigCorp asked explicitly for 12-month pin + data residency. A handful of SMBs asked for auto-migrations + credits. We should codify tiers (enterprise, standard, auto) so expectations are clear.

maria: Agree. For pin acceptance criteria I propose: stability (>99.8% success rate), no regression on 5 core eval suites (safety, instruction-following, summarization, Q&A, embeddings), perf within 10% of baseline. If any fail, model stays unpinned.

aj: Rollout ops: recommend canary sequence 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 24h windows and automated rollback if error rate increases > 0.5pp or latency jumps > 20%. Need automatic fallback to previous variant.

sam: Eval infra notes: we need 3 buckets — synthetic prompt set, live-sampled requests, and a small human review panel (20-30 checks) for subjective regressions. Estimate ~2 weeks to assemble evals + 1 week to run and triage.

lin: Migration incentives idea: 2 months credits or one month of dedicated capacity for enterprise customers who complete migration within 90 days. Also offer migration support calls.

maria: Deprecation cadence suggestion: soft-deprecation notice at 60 days, compatibility shim for top 10 customers for additional 90 days on request, hard-retire at 150 days total. Exceptions processed via a formal review.

aj: Edge case: quantized variants can change tokens/behavior. Suggest a small tool: `python tools/compat_check.py --from v1 --to v2 --sample 1000` to get a quick delta report. Also add a checklist in the runbook for tokenization/embedding drift.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI — release freeze next Tue 00:00–06:00 UTC. Any canaries must avoid that window.

maria: Next steps: aj owns the rollout playbook (canary config + rollback hooks), sam owns eval sets & gating scripts, lin consolidates customer asks & incentive language. I'll draft a launch-criteria doc and loop in legal for contract pin language.

aj: :thumbsup: Thurs 11am sync works for engineering.

sam: Works for me.

lin: I'll bring the BigCorp constraint list and known customers who might request exceptions.

maria: Thanks — I'll post the doc link after this thread and tag owners. If anyone has blocking constraints please speak up here. :sparkles:
